claim_boundary: Scores are independent expert diagnostics of the exported pixels and intended surface fit. They are not measured audience preference, production approval, runtime truth, or proof of the depicted systems.

outcomes.22-25: iterate once with a targeted change

rubric.governance_override: Missing atomic prompt receipts, crop proof, live surface QA, and founder approval keep every asset at research_candidate.

system_findings: Specialty is most legible when morphology and visible work artifacts express the job.
Large round eyes, short legs, and small bodies repeatedly create baby-schema and mascot drift.
Multi-legged bodies repeatedly read as arachnid and lower broad human comfort even when craft is high.
Circular orbit diagrams, node constellations, fake holograms, and ceremonial black-gold chambers are overused and weaken brand ownability.
Humanlike lids, lashes, lips, high heels, and gendered fashion create anthropomorphic-deception and authority-coding risks.
Phase I04 is the only 26/30 diagnostic because it shows a supervised multi-agent workflow with separate roles and a human gate; it remains governance-blocked research.

candidates.next_hypothesis: Replace the orbit prop with a concrete delegation artifact and neutralize ceremonial fashion cues.

candidates.next_hypothesis: Keep the utility silhouette but reduce eye size and replace the orbit probe with a task-specific instrument.
